'As an additional cost to play Express Lightning, you may **charge** your hero's soul.' Light Warrior Action - Attack (ArmoryDeckBoltyn). The ENTIRE printed text is one optional additional play cost, so it is authored as the TOP-LEVEL cost dict - the shape tests/test_card_json_hygiene.py sanctions for a card whose only implementable clause is that cost (compiles to CardDef.play_cost at loader.py:148-151, checked by play.py:567-568 and paid in apply_action at play.py:1146-1147). An ability-level additional_cost was rejected: this card has no payoff effects, and an ability with an empty effects list fails test_every_ability_has_effects. Shape copied verbatim from .drafts/express_lightning_blue.json - identical sentence, Monarch printing; no amount differs between printings.

PLUMBING VERIFIED: loader._compile_cost (loader.py:93-98) forwards every non-'type' key into params, so 'optional' reaches the handler; the CHARGE cost handler (cost_types.py:266-318) reads amount/optional(/may). With optional truthy, can_pay returns True unconditionally, so DECLINING the charge never blocks the play - official release note 1 ('Charging is optional. You may play the card without charging') verbatim. 'optional' is authored as boolean true, copied from shipped dtd/light_the_way_red.json and the blue sibling; NOTE for future editors that this handler bool()-s the value raw, so the string "FALSE" would read as OPTIONAL - never author "FALSE" on a CHARGE cost.

amount 1 is release note 2 ('You may only charge up to one card unless otherwise specified').

Release note 3 ('A card may not charge itself') holds BY CONSTRUCTION, not by authoring: apply_action removes the played card from its source zone (play.py:1135-1138) BEFORE play_cost.pay_fn runs (:1146-1147), so the played card is never among the hand cards the CHARGE prompt offers.

Release notes 4-5 need nothing authored: the charged card goes face up under the hero via the canonical effect_keywords.charge primitive the handler calls, and note 5's 'considered to have charged' marker only matters for payoff clauses asking what was charged - this card has none.

DB KEYWORD NOT AUTHORED: 'Charge' sits in printed_keywords but no engine path consumes it (build_keyword_triggers treats a printed Charge as pass, triggers/triggers.py ~370; greps of card_keywords/costs/play found no reader), so this cost IS the whole implementation - authoring anything more would double-charge. Proven shape: shipped dtd/beaming_bravado_* and light_the_way_red, drafted engulfing_light_red/bolt_of_courage_*/cross_the_line_* carry the same sentence.
